formal_run_gate: freeze a real ModelAdapter and exact token-matched condition matrix after reviewing this harness pilot
independent_random_streams: task seeds derive from seed, task type, and instance only; condition is excluded from generation
inference_unit: per-seed mean over the matched task suite
known_limitations: The deterministic adapter and evidence task grammar are designed test doubles.
A performance difference validates a causal path, not biological realism or emergence.
single_long_context intentionally uses fewer calls; compute is reported rather than padded.
Three pilot seeds cannot support precise inferential claims.
model: DeterministicModelAdapter shared unchanged by every condition

primary_hypotheses.H1: brain_full improves regime-switch and fault recovery over equal-cap baselines
primary_hypotheses.H2: memory selectively improves delayed recall and distributed evidence integration
primary_hypotheses.H3: error monitoring selectively improves injected-fault recovery
primary_hypotheses.H4: adaptive routing avoids robust calls on low-conflict tasks
primary_hypotheses.H5: different histories can produce persistent choices that follow memory reset/swap

status: pre-registered deterministic pilot; not a formal LLM result
